metadata.name: attestation_validator
metadata.description: Stoppage attestation validator: verifies an operator-signed sports statistic observation (ed25519 precompile, same transaction) and returns a bool over CPI

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: One-time init of the Config PDA pinning the operator authority
whose ed25519 signatures this validator accepts. Permissionless,
deploying their own would init this themselves).

instructions.name: validate_attestation
docs: Verify an operator-signed observation against the claimed
predicate and return the result as a 1-byte bool in return data.
Fails (reverts) on any binding or window violation.
predicates, reference is the scheduled full-time; the window
stops a stale observation answering a fresh claim.

accounts.name: config
docs: The Config PDA carrying the pinned authority. Anchor checks
owner + discriminator; seeds pin it to the canonical PDA.

errors.name: MissingInstructionsSysvar
errors.msg: Instructions account is not the instructions sysvar

errors.name: MissingEd25519Instruction
errors.msg: Preceding instruction is not the ed25519 precompile

errors.name: CrossInstructionReference
errors.msg: Ed25519 verification must be self-contained in one instruction

errors.name: SignerMismatch
errors.msg: Signer is not the pinned attestation authority

errors.name: MessageMismatch
errors.msg: Signed message does not match the claimed observation

errors.name: BeforeReference
errors.msg: Observation timestamp is before the reference time

errors.name: OutsideWindow
errors.msg: Observation is outside the committed window

fields.name: authority
docs: The operator key whose ed25519-precompile-verified observations
